history.applied: Template “{{name}}” applied. Open KusStudio to continue editing.

history.title: Version history
history.desc: A version is saved each time the design changes. Versions sent to export are pinned and never removed.
history.noVersions: No saved versions yet. Save a design in KusStudio to start the history.
history.tplDesc: Applying a template replaces the current design (the old one stays in the history).
history.restoreDesc: The current design is replaced by this version. Nothing is lost: your current design stays in the history.
history.applyDesc: The current design is replaced by the template. It stays available in the version history.
